personality: 4 Tactile / Playful with 7 Dark-First Utility coloring
personality_one_liner: A premium, vibrant, and tactile Arabic gaming experience that balances luxurious dark modes with playful, rounded interfaces.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use safe area insets. Maintain RTL layouts: right-aligned text, left-aligned chevrons.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar.
Use translucent purple gradients overlaid on game cards.
Apply glass effects on the sticky header for smooth scrolling.
dont's: Don't blur dense data text areas.
Don't use glass on solid primary buttons.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main dashboard for game discovery, featuring hero banner, stats, and game categories.

states.loading: Shimmer effect on game cards and hero banner.

screens.layout: RTL orientation. Header: Avatar top-right, notifications and coins top-left. Search bar with embedded 'اللعب مع الأصدقاء' (Play with friends) pill. Hero Card: Purple gradient with reading brain mascot on the left (RTL mirrored). Horizontal stats strip (rating, users, games, rank). Featured Game Cards (vertical list): Each with a themed gradient (Quiz=Orange/Red, Puzzle=Purple/Pink, Word=Teal/Green). Horizontal carousel for 'Upcoming Games' with dark cards and Gold 'قريبًا' badges. Footer text: 'تم تطوير هذا التطبيق بواسطة أبو خلف'.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The entire app must be RTL (Right-to-Left) for Arabic. Use I18nManager.forceRTL(true) or handle flex-direction: 'row-reverse' / appropriate layout mirroring. Text should be right-aligned.
Use 'Tajawal' font for all text to ensure elegant Arabic typography.
Implement both Dark Mode and Light Mode, with Dark Mode as the default/primary aesthetic using the deep navy (#0B0B14) and purple (#7C5CFF) tokens.
Hero card should have a rich purple gradient background with the brain mascot image placed on the left side (due to RTL reading flow, text goes on the right).
Use a vibrant gold/amber (#F5B301) for primary Call-to-Action buttons ('ابدأ اللعب') and 'قريبًا' (Coming Soon) badges.

Ensure the bottom tab bar has 5 items: الرئيسية (Home), الألعاب (Games), التصنيف (Leaderboard), الإنجازات (Achievements), الملف الشخصي (Profile). Selected state should use purple with an underline indicator.
Add a fixed footer at the bottom of the home screen content with the text: 'تم تطوير هذا التطبيق بواسطة أبو خلف'.
The search bar must include a purple embedded pill for 'اللعب مع الأصدقاء' (Play with friends).
Featured game cards must use thematic gradients: Quiz (Orange/Red), Puzzle (Purple/Pink), Word (Teal/Green).
Do NOT use standard blue colors unless requested; stick strictly to the user-provided Purple/Navy/Gold palette.
